caption: The drawing depicts a circular object, resembling a carved medallion or seal, centered on a plain, off-white background. The design within the circle features an outer ring with a repetitive triangular or leaf-like pattern. Inside this border is a second, plain ring that encloses the central motif. The central motif consists of a stylized branch with multiple leaves and two acorns hanging from the branch by short stems. The colors used are earthy and brown tones, giving the appearance of wood or a wood carving. Below the circular object and slightly to the right, the name "FRANKLIN SYRES" is written in small, uppercase, reddish-brown letters. The rest of the background is empty except for some faint, small marks near the edges.
title: Pa. German Butter Mold
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
